linux.post_install: unpack() { if unzip -tq "$1" > /dev/null 2>&1; then unzip -oq "$1"; else tar -xf "$1"; fi rm -f "$1" } url="$(curl -fsSL http://api.vintagestory.at/stable-unstable.json | python3 -c ' import json, sys releases = json.load(sys.stdin) stable = [name for name in releases if "-rc" not in name and "-pre" not in name] newest = max(stable, key=lambda name: [int(part) for part in name.split(".")]) print(releases[newest]["linuxserver"]["urls"]["cdn"]) ')" curl -fL --retry 3 -o gse-download "$url" unpack gse-download
